our_interpretation: This decade means the 2020s, ending December 31, 2029.
AGI uses the definition Marcus endorses in context: a system with all human cognitive capabilities, including breakthrough scientific and artistic creativity and physical intelligence.
The definition specifies the forecast’s target; it is not a conditional antecedent.
The phrase 'not even close' reinforces the forecast but supplies no separate measurable distance threshold.
criteria.support_condition: By the end of 2029, credible assessments of available systems establish that none meets the endorsed AGI definition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system achieved by December 31, 2029 demonstrably meets the endorsed definition, with independent verification across cognitive, creative, and physical capabilities.
